OrbitOutlineTextField.snippet:
OrbitOutlineTextField(
    value = "{value}",
    onValueChange = { },
    enabled = {enabled},
    isError = {isError},
    visualTransformation = if ({password}) PasswordVisualTransformation() else VisualTransformation.None,
    // focused = {focused} is an interaction state
)

OrbitFilterChip.snippet:
OrbitFilterChip(
    selected = {selected},
    onClick = { },
    label = "Label",
    enabled = {enabled},
    // {state} is an interaction state
)

Checkbox.snippet:
Checkbox(
    checked = {checked},
    onCheckedChange = null,
    enabled = {enabled},
    colors = CheckboxDefaults.colors(
        checkedColor = OrbitTheme.colors.brand.primary,
        uncheckedColor = OrbitTheme.colors.text.secondary,
        checkmarkColor = OrbitTheme.colors.surface.background,
        disabledCheckedColor = OrbitTheme.colors.border.disabled,
        disabledUncheckedColor = OrbitTheme.colors.border.disabled,
    ),
)
